name: gizza-ai/xsalsa20-cipher
summary: Encrypt or decrypt data with XSalsa20 using a 32-byte key and 24-byte nonce

tool.description: Encrypt or decrypt UTF-8 data with XSalsa20, the extended-nonce Salsa20 stream cipher. operation=encrypt returns ciphertext encoded as hex/base64; operation=decrypt decodes the ciphertext and returns UTF-8 plaintext. The key must be exactly 32 bytes and the nonce exactly 24 bytes. Never reuse a key+nonce pair.

counter.description: Initial 64-byte block counter, default 0. The data must end before block 2^64-1; the keystream is not wrapped.

data.description: Plaintext for operation=encrypt; ciphertext encoded as format for operation=decrypt.

format.description: Ciphertext/key/nonce encoding when key_format=encoded: hex or base64.

key.description: XSalsa20 key: exactly 32 bytes. By default key_format=encoded, so it is read as hex or base64 according to format.

key_format.description: How to read key and nonce: encoded = hex/base64 according to format; text = raw UTF-8 bytes.

nonce.description: XSalsa20 nonce: exactly 24 bytes. Never reuse the same key+nonce pair for different messages.

operation.description: Encrypt plaintext or decrypt ciphertext. XSalsa20 is symmetric; the same key, nonce, and counter reverse the operation.
